Privacy policy

Last updated 6 November 2026

This site is a demo of VaultDB, a personal open-source project by Abdul Raiyaan. It has no accounts, no advertising and no tracking. This page explains the little it does handle.

Your data stays in your browser

  • The playground. VaultDB runs inside your browser tab as WebAssembly. The commands you type and the data they create stay in that tab's memory and are never sent to any server. Closing or reloading the tab, or pressing "Empty my database", deletes them.
  • Ask the docs. Questions are answered in your browser too, by searching a copy of VaultDB's documentation that comes with the page. Your questions are not sent anywhere.
  • No cookies and no browser storage are used.

Hosting

The site's files are served by Vercel. Like any web host, Vercel receives your IP address and basic request details (such as the page asked for and your browser type) to deliver the files and protect the service, under Vercel's privacy policy. This site does not use Vercel's analytics.

What is not collected

No names, emails, analytics, fingerprinting or third-party scripts. Fonts and all other files are served from this site, so your browser does not contact other companies when you visit.

Contact

Questions about this policy: open an issue on GitHub.

Built by Abdul Raiyaan.
